plan_review.notes: Alt A aggregate multi-level gains into one +N floater was rejected to preserve the original per-level feedback requirement. Alt B add stack metadata to the shared floater contract was rejected as extra surface area for a renderer-owned readability concern. Reused the existing main-scene probe floating-text seam instead of adding a new observability surface, made the audit fix explicit by bumping brace-expansion/minimatch overrides and rerunning security:audit, and changed staggering to per-frame position clusters so already-live floaters do not affect new notices.

rounds.notes: One blocker found: the newly added 3-apple v2 review ledger was still scaffold-only and would fail pr-review-ledger/test:guards. Resolved by recording the completed plan-review stage, this code-review stage, and running the independent-grade flow before final validation.

independent_grade.notes: The event is emitted exactly when player skills gain levels, bounded for headless runs, deterministically rendered and drained, and correctly wired through existing VFX infrastructure. Unit, gameplay, and real-scene e2e tests cover emission, suppression, multi-level gains, queue bounds, rendering, cleanup, and staggering. Fast validation and targeted tests pass. Scope is disciplined overall, though dependency security overrides slightly broaden the feature diff.
